name: mappy
label: Mappy
author: Brian McLeer, City of Grand Junction
description: A friendly folded-map assistant for any Experience Builder app. Users chat with him to find tools, pages, links, layers and features; he opens widgets, switches layers, zooms and answers questions from everything in the app. A deep scan in the builder teaches him the web maps, every field and coded value, item descriptions and widget docs. Runs entirely in the browser.
